tasks.Boundary Evaluation: Evaluate the function at boundary values of x and y to check for maximums.
tasks.Critical Points Identification: Find critical points of the function by setting partial derivatives equal to zero.
tasks.Function Analysis: Analyze the function f(x,y) to understand its behavior within the given domain.
tasks.Objective Clarification: Understand the problem statement and identify key variables and constraints.
tasks.Optimization Verification: Verify if identified points are indeed maxima using second derivative test or other methods.
